scope: Quick Checklist at 5,000 rows, one window. Debug Swift test harness (BenchmarkTests), system WKWebView on macOS 26 (Darwin 25.6). Single runs per variant.

method.bench: HITSLOP_BENCH_ROWS=5000 HITSLOP_BENCH_WINDOWS=1 HITSLOP_BENCH_LABEL=<label> [HITSLOP_BENCH_CSS=<rule>] bun run bench:windows
method.row_text_split_ms: Row text edit: owner round trip and JS until the row's DOM changes (js), forced style (getComputedStyle), forced layout (offsetHeight), remainder until a timer runs (rest); records = DOM mutation records across the whole list

question: frame_after_row_text_edit grew from 342 ms (2026-09-29) to 802 ms (09-30) and 961 ms (10-01)

attribution.finding: The SDK and Svelte cost 8 ms and touch only the edited row (4 DOM records). The cost was WebKit restyling the whole list: every row carried a hidden ::after mirror with content: attr(data-value), inside a container-type: inline-size ancestor. Removing either the size container or the per-row attr() mirror removes the full-list style recalc. The mirror was added on 2026-09-29 (CSS grid auto-grow).

fix: Quick Checklist: only the row being edited carries data-value, and the mirror renders only on .checklist-grow[data-value]. Text rows size themselves; the textarea still auto-grows from the mirror. SDK: OwnerDocument.register skips already-mapped list rows and record entries before building their path.
remaining: About 170-280 ms per edit at 5,000 rows is system WebKit laying out the list (click: forced layout; row text: the rendering update after it), as measured on 2026-09-29 (5 ms at 500 rows, 167 ms at 5,000; Playwright WebKit 6 ms). content-visibility: auto adds about 40 ms per rendering update at this size (title frame 46-49 ms vs 8 ms without it). 1,000 rows is the product target; windowing the list is a template design change for its own round.
authoring_note: A per-item CSS attr() mirror inside a size container restyles every item when one item's attribute changes in system WebKit. Render such mirrors only where they are needed.

ab_20_windows.note: Old and new checklist mirror run back to back under the same memory pressure (16 GB of 17.4 GB swap in use). Isolated 20-window runs on a swapping machine varied from 13.3 s to 24.6 s at 5,000 rows, so compare only back-to-back pairs.
